Only facts re-verified against the cloned tree at the pinned SHA are included; the tree at SHA is ground truth.

ambiguities.detail: The product's API is NOT in the Next.js app: apps/backend/src/main.ts (NestJS; imports express json — verified at SHA) is the API server. The frontend has exactly ONE route.ts (uploads catch-all). Cross-references frontend→backend are HTTP calls, not imports — the import graph has a hard boundary here. A Next-only tool must not fabricate API routes from page files. Surfaced as unknown/not-claimed (out of v0.1-alpha scope).

Proxy locale detection + auth gating (/modal/* without auth cookie → /auth/login-required; public prefixes /uploads/, /p/, /provider/, /icons/, /oauth/authorize, /integrations/social/) are literal startsWith checks — extractable as rules (R from proxy source); enforcement outcomes need cookie/session (I). v0.1-alpha detects the proxy entry; the rule list is beyond current scope.
